purpose: Public external datasets allowed to inform chemistry-level thermal-response models without mixing incompatible PUR endpoints.

sources.article_title: Machine learning of polyurethane prepolymer viscosity: a comparison of chemical and physicochemical approaches
allowed_scientific_use: derive one temperature-response descriptor per complete prepolymer curve
test which chemistry families preserve or change thermal-response shape
train formulation-level models with group-held-out validation
forbidden_shortcuts: do not randomly split individual temperature points from the same formulation across train and test
do not use this dataset as a thermal-hold stability label source
do not treat apparent rheological E_eta as a molecular reaction activation energy
sources.raw_data_policy: Download at runtime; do not vendor the third-party raw workbooks into this repository. Preserve source URL, archive hash and derived artifact provenance.
sources.raw_data_license: Follow the upstream repository and article terms; this workflow records provenance and does not relicense third-party data.
